description: This file defines a class for configuring and transforming requests and responses for the Fireworks AI Rerank API, including URL construction, parameter mapping, environment validation, request transformation, and response parsing.

classes.name: FireworksAIRerankConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Fireworks AI Rerank API, including URL generation, parameter mapping, environment validation, request transformation, and response parsing.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the complete API URL based on base URL and model.

methods.name: get_supported_cohere_rerank_params
methods.description: Returns list of supported rerank parameters for Cohere models.

methods.name: map_cohere_rerank_params
methods.description: Maps input parameters to Fireworks AI rerank API parameters.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Validates and constructs headers with API key for environment setup.

methods.name: transform_rerank_request
methods.description: Transforms rerank request parameters into Fireworks AI API request format.

methods.name: transform_rerank_response
methods.description: Parses and converts Fireworks AI rerank API response into internal RerankResponse format.
